name: Clément Delangue
bio: Clément Delangue is a co-founder and the chief executive of Hugging Face, the company behind the Hugging Face Hub and the Transformers library. The company was founded in 2016 and began as a chatbot app before becoming a machine learning platform. Delangue is a co-author of the Transformers and Datasets library papers.
known_for: Growing the Hugging Face Hub for models and datasets
